Online session
An account is optional. Local communication works without signing in. You can verify your email to create or restore an online session; this does not delete boards or change analytics consent.
Optional email verification
Privacy and support

Local boards, recordings and speech text are not sent to our servers. Optional email verification sends your email to api.identity.linka.su. With separate permission, metrics.nkolinka.ru receives action types, results, an installation identifier and technical app/device information. You can withdraw analytics consent in settings.
Privacy policy

Delete account

Request deletion of your LINKa Pictures online account and its associated server data, not accounts in other products. Analytics stops on this device. Boards, recordings, drafts and assistant protection on this device are not deleted. You can continue local communication without an account. Deletion is complete only after the server confirms it.

Optional usage analytics

Off by default. With permission, send safe action types and completion results to metrics.nkolinka.ru. Never send email, speech text, board names, cards, images or recordings. Turning this off immediately stops collection and clears the local queue; an offline withdrawal is sent when connected.
